governance_rules.name: Executive Summary with Visual Progress Bars Required
Phase N+1: Teardown + REFACTOR + Commit Mandatory
Plan Files Must Live Within Plan Folder Structure
Type Hints Required for All Functions/Methods
Docstrings Required for All Public APIs
Explicit Error Handling with Custom Exceptions
All Development Must Go Through TDD-Master Orchestrator
Orchestrators Must Not Create Markdown Work Products
All MCP Tools MUST Use @mcp_tool Decorator
MCP Server Unity - Single Registry Authority
